answer_2.quote: We use four metrics to evaluate detector effectiveness: (1) Macro-F1: Measures balance between misalignment detection and usability. (2) Total Detection Errors (TDE): Sum of false negatives ... and positives ... (3) Effective Reliability (ER) ... (4) PR-AUC: Captures performance across thresholds.

answer_3.quote: Direct Prompt. This approach represents the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm, where the model is directly prompted to judge the correctness of a trajectory.

answer_4.guideline: Human users provide feedback to the Actor when InferAct flags a misaligned trajectory.
